title: Model/capability strategy chosen too early (at creation); no post-ideation or post-architect gate to match modality/architecture

rcca.root_cause: Tier/models were fixed at creation and preflight ran before any stage, so the strategy could not reflect the idea modality (known at 0a) or the architecture (known at 2).
rcca.corrective: core/model_strategy.py: Gate A post-0a (detect modality, enable packs, coarse kinds, recompose DAG) + Gate B post-architect (refine concrete models; apply via agent override store); wired into stage_runner; no-op for text.
rcca.preventive: Plain-text projects are a strict no-op (nothing written); LLM changes go through the BI-0178 override store; media-OUT is a generator id (never a chat model); recommend-first (PIPELINE_MODEL_STRATEGY=warn default).
rcca.fixed_where: core/model_strategy.py; core/orchestrator/stage_runner.py (gates A/B); config/store-registry.json; config/env-flags.json; scripts/pipeline.py; test-framework/tests/pipeline/test_model_strategy.py
